name: DXY down-thrust trend-confirmed — long crypto only when the dollar breaks down AND a crypto trend is building (adx)
rationale: MECHANISM: same inverse-dollar thesis (a weaker dollar loosens global conditions and re-rates risk; crypto front-runs slow FX/rates transmission), but the crypto confirmation is a TREND read (adx building above a floor) rather than a range reclaim — so this variant only takes the dollar-weakness long when directional momentum is already established, avoiding chop where DXY drifts but crypto goes nowhere. Distinct feature (adx vs range_position) and a distinct trade profile (ride an established trend vs buy a reclaim). DISCONFIRMER: identical to the reclaim variant — the BTC-dollar correlation may have FLIPPED POSITIVE in the 2024-2026 ETF cycle (JPMorgan Mar 2026), making an inverse-DXY long backwards. Kill unless the inverse tie is strictly OOS-live in 2024-2026 net of fees. Also kill if the adx trend filter alone (a pure crypto-momentum spec) captures the same OOS Sharpe without the DXY gate — the dollar feature must add lift over price-only momentum.
catalyst: dollar breakdown with an established crypto uptrend
